frequency_question: What proportion of proposed fintech/digital lending regulatory frameworks by the RBI reach final enforced implementation within three years of initial public consultation?
membership_rule: Includes all formal discussion papers, draft guidelines, and proposed regulatory frameworks issued by the RBI specifically targeting digital lending, P2P lending, payment aggregators, or NBFC-digital lending standards between 2018 and 2024. Excludes general annual monetary policy statements and routine circulars.

cases.name: Guidelines on Outsourcing of Financial Services by NBFCs
Payment Aggregators and Payment Gateways Framework
Framework for Scale Based Regulation for NBFCs
Draft Directions on Default Loss Guarantee (DLG) in Digital Lending

provenance_note: rate of 100% from only 7 case(s); too few to establish an extreme base rate -- treat as directional
coverage_note: 7 named major fintech/digital lending regulatory proposals; all 7 proceeded to final implementation within the window.
known_gaps: Some minor consultative papers or highly specialized technical standards may have been merged or prolonged, but all major structural frameworks tracked here reached final notification.
validity_reason: RBI's regulatory methodology and institutional pace for digital financial oversight have remained consistent over multiple years and are unlikely to shift abruptly before the target deadline.
